\section[(dialogue)]{Can, want and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R130-first-pass-can-want-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bedsheet and a mattress.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to be able to, to manage to, a skill, ability, a right
  \item a means, an owner, strength, wanted, a wish
  \item a need, hope, a dream, to ask for, to decide
  \item a plan, dawn, midnight, the day after tomorrow, Monday
  \item Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To be able to? (\textbf{\mr{शकणे}}, \emph{śakṇe}.) To manage to? (\textbf{\mr{जमणे}}, \emph{jamṇe}.) A skill? (\textbf{\mr{कौशल्य}}, \emph{kauśalya}.) Ability? (\textbf{\mr{क्षमता}}, \emph{kṣamatā}.) A right? (\textbf{\mr{अधिकार}}, \emph{adhikār}.) A means? (\textbf{\mr{साधन}}, \emph{sādhan}.) An owner? (\textbf{\mr{मालक}}, \emph{mālak}.) Strength? (\textbf{\mr{ताकद}}, \emph{tākad}.) Wanted? (\textbf{\mr{हवा}}, \emph{havā}.) A wish? (\textbf{\mr{इच्छा}}, \emph{icchā}.) A need? (\textbf{\mr{गरज}}, \emph{garaj}.) Hope? (\textbf{\mr{आशा}}, \emph{āśā}.) A dream? (\textbf{\mr{स्वप्न}}, \emph{svapna}.) To ask for? (\textbf{\mr{मागणे}}, \emph{māgṇe}.) To decide? (\textbf{\mr{ठरवणे}}, \emph{ṭharavṇe}.) A plan? (\textbf{\mr{योजना}}, \emph{yojanā}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\mr{पहाट}}, \emph{pahāṭ}.) Midnight? (\textbf{\mr{मध्यरात्र}}, \emph{madhyarātra}.) The day after tomorrow? (\textbf{\mr{परवा}}, \emph{parvā}.) Monday? (\textbf{\mr{सोमवार}}, \emph{somvār}.) Tuesday? (\textbf{\mr{मंगळवार}}, \emph{maṅgaḷvār}.) Wednesday? (\textbf{\mr{बुधवार}}, \emph{budhvār}.) Thursday? (\textbf{\mr{गुरुवार}}, \emph{guruvār}.) Friday? (\textbf{\mr{शुक्रवार}}, \emph{śukravār}.) Saturday? (\textbf{\mr{शनिवार}}, \emph{śanivār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Time and places — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R130-second-pass-time-and-places}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for Sunday and a date.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item Sunday, a date, at present, every day, summer
  \item winter, the monsoon, straight, a turn, a corner
  \item a square, a garden, a park, an airport, a hospital
  \item a library, a restaurant, the post, a building, a bathroom
  \item a courtyard, a door, a pillow, a bedsheet, a mattress
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Sunday? (\textbf{\mr{रविवार}}, \emph{ravivār}.) A date? (\textbf{\mr{तारीख}}, \emph{tārīkh}.) At present? (\textbf{\mr{सध्या}}, \emph{sadhyā}.) Every day? (\textbf{\mr{रोज}}, \emph{roj}.) Summer? (\textbf{\mr{उन्हाळा}}, \emph{unhāḷā}.) Winter? (\textbf{\mr{हिवाळा}}, \emph{hivāḷā}.) The monsoon? (\textbf{\mr{पावसाळा}}, \emph{pāvsāḷā}.) Straight? (\textbf{\mr{सरळ}}, \emph{saraḷ}.) A turn? (\textbf{\mr{वळण}}, \emph{vaḷaṇ}.) A corner? (\textbf{\mr{कोपरा}}, \emph{koprā}.) A square? (\textbf{\mr{चौक}}, \emph{cauk}.) A garden? (\textbf{\mr{बाग}}, \emph{bāg}.) A park? (\textbf{\mr{उद्यान}}, \emph{udyān}.) An airport? (\textbf{\mr{विमानतळ}}, \emph{vimāntaḷ}.) A hospital? (\textbf{\mr{रुग्णालय}}, \emph{rugṇālay}.) A library? (\textbf{\mr{ग्रंथालय}}, \emph{granthālay}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\mr{उपहारगृह}}, \emph{upahārgṛh}.) The post? (\textbf{\mr{टपाल}}, \emph{ṭapāl}.) A building? (\textbf{\mr{इमारत}}, \emph{imārat}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{\mr{न्हाणीघर}}, \emph{nhāṇīghar}.) A courtyard? (\textbf{\mr{अंगण}}, \emph{aṅgaṇ}.) A door? (\textbf{\mr{दरवाजा}}, \emph{darvājā}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\mr{उशी}}, \emph{uśī}.) A bedsheet? (\textbf{\mr{चादर}}, \emph{cādar}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\mr{गादी}}, \emph{gādī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
